summary: Offscreen forces: aggregate bodies that are raised, dispatched along real Geography routes one hop at a time, and arrive carrying exactly the composition they left with.

coordination.notes: expedition.rs is touched in exactly three hunks (a `forces` field appended at the end of the struct, its initialiser at the end of the literal in new(), and one line in strategic_tick between run_hour and the journal push) plus the use; every ExpeditionState method this lane needs lives in an impl block inside strategy/force.rs, because two other lanes are appending to the same tail and one is changing resolve_midnight_in's signature. tick.rs gains four StrategicEvent variants appended at the end of the enum and nothing else -- run_hour, PURPOSES, the draws and the digest are untouched. Materialisation through spawn sockets is B11's: this lane stops at the ForceArrived event and the forces_at reader.
